title: Fondamantal — Admin Dashboard
label: Internal Tooling / Content Management
summary: A purpose-built internal control center for managing content and publishing workflows without touching code.

sections.title: Overview
sections.body: The Admin Dashboard is the internal control center for the Fondamantal platform—tailored to platform structure and real workflows.

sections.title: The Problem
sections.body: Manual updates and generic CMS tools create inefficiency, workflow mismatch, and higher risk of errors during publishing.

sections.title: The Solution
sections.body: A custom admin interface focused on content separation, predictable publishing paths, minimal UI complexity, and platform-specific controls.

sections.title: Key Features
bullets: Purpose-built controls aligned with platform needs
Clear publishing workflow to reduce mistakes
Foundation for controlled access and roles

sections.title: Outcome
sections.body: Reduced operational overhead and improved independence—content can be managed confidently without developer intervention.

sections.title: Key Takeaway
sections.body: Custom internal tools improve operational efficiency when designed around real workflows.

cta.headline: Need internal tools built for your workflow?
cta.body: If your project requires dashboards or admin panels tailored to real operations, I'd be happy to review it.
